newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet weakens as NYMEX, diffs slide lower.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet weakens as NYMEX, diffs slide lower.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices fell sharply Thursday as both differentials and NYMEX futures weakened.
Jet fuel diffs had rallied about three cents last week as refiners bid prices higher.
"It climbed fast and has a lot farther to fall," one player said, adding he had been expecting the recent rally to fizzle.
U.S. Gulf 54-grade jet fuel for 4th cycle delivery on the Colonial Pipeline was offered at 1.10 cents over the screen, about 0.50 cents off Wednesday's levels.
New York Harbor prompt 54-grade jet activity was very choppy with players putting the "get-done" level at 6.00 cents over the screen.
